description:
* POSITION DESCRIPTION


 JOB TITLE : Customer Relationship Officer
   

  

 GRADE : O/AM\-I/AM\-II
   

  

 DEPARTMENT : MICROBANKING
   

  

 LOCATION : Branch
   

  

 SUB\-DEPARTMENT : TYPE OF POSITION : Full\-time
   

  

 REPORTS TO : Assistant Customer Relationship Manager
   

  

 REPORTING INTO
   

  

 NA
   

  

* ROLE PURPOSE \& OBJECTIVE


* Manages banking relationship with 650 families within the geographic area of control by offering full range of banking services
* Directly responsible to acquire new customers for Group Lending (GL) business and servicing existing customers
* Upsell loans to right customers and family members based on requirement and capacity to repay
* Offer and onboard Savings Accounts and other deposit products to customer, their family members and their references
* Deliver prompt customer services; be accessible to customers at all times for GL, IL and Family Banking queries
* G enerate quality leads for cross\-selling for third party products offered by Ujjivan Small finance Bank.
* Provide timely loan for eligible repeat and top\-up customers.
* Adherence to the defined set of processes and circulars.
* SIZE OF THE ROLE


 FINANCIAL SIZE
   

  

 NON\-FINANCIAL SIZE
   

  

 Portfolio Managed\- Customers handled\-
 - Number of portfolio products\- Group Loan, Individual Loan, CASA, TD and TPP products

- KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

**Business/ Financials**
* Meet the set targets on Group Loans (GL) in terms of open market acquisition and repeat GL loans
* Convert GL customers, family member and referrals for Family Banking in terms of opening Savings Accounts and maintaining minimum balance
* Actively source term deposits (FD and RD) from Family members of GL customers
* Offer suitable Insurance products to customer and family members to provide adequate insurance coverage
* Identify, process and refer GL customers who can be potentially given Individual loans either unsecured /secured
* Share customer insights/product related feedback with the ACRM


**Customer**
* Ensure customers and Family members are educated about entire bouquet of banking products (Loans – GL, IL, Secured, Deposits \& Insurance) offered by Ujjivan
* Interact with customers in a courteous and professional manner; provide prompt, efficient and accurate services
* Ensure timely insurance claim settlement for his/her customers
* Resolve customer queries/ pertaining to GL, IL \& Family Banking within specified timelines


**Internal Process**
* Identify and conduct surveys of new working areas for group formation and conducts projection meeting for GL and Family Banking
* Group Loans: Fill customer profile forms, Loan Application form with accuracy and collects supporting documents for account opening in strict adherence to KYC norms followed by a Compulsory Group Training (CGTs)
* Individual loans (for certified CROs): Analyze existing customer profile and repayment capacity, fill customer profile forms, Loan Application form with accuracy and collects supporting documents for account opening in strict adherence to KYC norms
* Coordinate with customers in the disbursement process
* Conduct Center Meeting as per schedule without fail and ensure timely repayments, collection of deposits for savings accounts / fixed deposit, updates all transactions on True\-Cell, an interface to track monetary transactions
* Open savings accounts for Customer and their Family members in Ujjivan
* Help to conduct the CSR activities and motivates customers to participate in the Financial Literacy Program
* Give the detailed field reports to ACRM and discuss field related issues
* Adherence to the defined set of processes and circulars.


**Learning \& Innovation**
* Maintain up to date knowledge of GL, IL and Family Banking products and services as well as a working knowledge of other products offered in the branch
* Ensure adherence to training man\-days/ mandatory training programs for self
* Ensure goal setting, mid\-year review and performance appraisal processes are completed within specified timelines
* MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS OF KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS


 Educational
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Graduate


**Experience**
* 0\-1 year experience for Graduates
* Field Experience preferably in product sales, banking or collection


 Certifications
   

  

* NA


 Functional Skills
   

  

* Knowledge on unsecured products
* Basic Computer knowledge (MS Office, Outlook) / Ease of technology usage
* Is fluent in the local languages and has a working knowledge of English


 Behavioral Skills
   

  

* Product selling skills
* Willingness to travel \& relocation as per business requirements and career opportunities
* Interpersonal skills
* Ability to interface (orally and in writing) with all levels of associates and customers
* Ability to manage teams and drive performance
* Training skills


 Competencies Required
   

  

* Building Relationship
* Driving Change
* Planning \& Organizing
* Collaboration
* KEY INTERACTIONS


 INTERNAL
   

  

 EXTERNAL
   

  

 Micro Banking team
   

  

 House visits to loan customers
   

  

 Branch Operations Team
   

  

 Officer\-Employee Engagement

Analyze and evaluate the loan applications, to determine the situation of the business, establish the risks, determine the capacity of repayment and the adequate loan amount for the customer’s needs, and also evaluate the family situation and stability

* Sales and marketing skills – across multiple products

title: Sales Engineer
description:
**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Sales Engineer role based in Hosur. The Sales Engineer will work closely with customers to understand their technical requirements, recommend appropriate YG\-1 cutting tools and solutions, and support the sales process from initial inquiry through post\-sale follow\-up. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include conducting product demonstrations, providing technical guidance on tool selection and applications, preparing quotations, and assisting in resolving technical issues at customer sites. The role also involves collaborating with the sales team to develop opportunities, maintaining strong relationships with key accounts, and providing feedback to internal teams on market needs and product performance. The Sales Engineer will document customer interactions, track opportunities, and contribute to continuous improvement of sales and support processes.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Technical Support skills to interpret customer requirements and provide effective tooling solutions.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales and Customer Service skills to build long\-term relationships and drive revenue growth.
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to present technical concepts, prepare proposals, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Relevant experience in cutting tools, machining, or metalworking industries is beneficial, along with familiarity with CNC operations and tooling applications.
* A diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field is preferred, with proficiency in MS Office and basic CRM tools.
* Candidates should be able to work on\-site in Hosur, travel to customer locations as needed, manage multiple priorities, and operate safely in industrial environments.

title: Key Accounts Manager
company: BASF Environmental Catalyst and Metal Solutions
description:
Leveraging its deep expertise as the global leader in catalysis and precious metals, BASF Environmental Catalyst and Metal Solutions (ECMS) serves customers in many industries including automotive, aerospace, indoor air quality, semiconductors and hydrogen economy, and provides full loop services with its precious metals trading and recycling offering. With a focus on circular solutions and sustainability, ECMS is committed to helping our customers create a cleaner, more sustainable world. Protecting our elements of life is our purpose and this inspires us to ever\-new solutions. ECMS operates globally in 15 countries with approximately 20 production sites and over 4,000 employees.
   

  

**Objectives of the Position**
 Based on Defined Account Strategy, execute the sales process and the sales specific implementation of Mobile Emission Catalyst business unit strategy at the customer interface. Develop lasting customer relationships to identify business trends in and beyond the customer scope while enabling cross\-business collaboration and synergies to maximize BASF value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic:**
* Develop and maintain strategic long\-term business relationships with respective accounts (all decision\-makers) to promote brand value
* Responsible to develop, implement, monitor, and guide Sales Strategies and key account management (including pricing implementation)
* New Business Development, Identify and attract new customers, pursue new applications, and interact with corresponding process and product developers of the potential customers, leading to profitable future business
* Drive initiatives to improve profitability by implementing value add value engineering (VAVE) measures and value sharing with key OEM’s.


**Planning \& Operational** 
**:**
* Responsibility for financial performance to achieve agreed\-on targets regarding gross margin costs for the business
* Provide accurate sales forecast, supporting efficient planning of RM, products
* Responsible for efficient management of receivable / payment collection, DIV, DSO
* Negotiate and close deals or contracts with customers and provide operational guidance and support to relevant functional departments, to ensure smooth implementation


**Leadership** 
**:**
* Work closely with regional / global team for effective cross collaboration
* Influence decision makers in a complex environment within and outside BASF at all levels, and drive actions / decisions without disciplinary responsibility


**Education** 
 : Bachelor’s degree in engineering with MBA (desired)
   

  

**Working Experience:** 
 Minimum 7 years of sales / B2B preferably with Auto / Auto ancillary Industry

title: Senior Merchandiser
description:
**Company Description** 
 Unique Textiles is a textile\-focused organization dedicated to delivering high\-quality fabrics and products to diverse retail and wholesale markets. The company emphasizes reliable supply, consistent quality, and responsive customer service to support long\-term partnerships. Team members collaborate closely across merchandising, production, and sales to align product offerings with market trends and client needs. Unique Textiles values professionalism, integrity, and continuous improvement, creating an environment where experienced merchandising professionals can contribute to business growth and innovation.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Senior Merchandiser will manage the end\-to\-end merchandising process, including product planning, assortment selection, and inventory coordination for textile lines. Responsibilities include analyzing sales data and market trends, developing merchandising strategies, and ensuring that product ranges meet customer demands and brand standards. The role involves close collaboration with production, sales, and marketing teams to align product availability, pricing, and promotional activities. The Senior Merchandiser will also maintain strong relationships with key customers, oversee visual and in\-store product presentations, and monitor performance to optimize margins and sell\-through. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Palladam.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills, including clear verbal and written interaction with internal teams and external customers.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to build and maintain long\-term relationships and handle inquiries and issues effectively.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Retail skills to drive revenue, manage assortments, and understand store\-level performance.
* Candidates should possess Marketing skills to support product positioning, promotional activities, and brand visibility.
* Experience in textile or apparel merchandising, with a solid understanding of fabrics, trims, and production timelines.
* Proficiency in using spreadsheets, merchandising tools, and basic data analysis to interpret sales and inventory reports.
* Strong organizational and time\-management abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy in planning and execution.
* Relevant diploma or degree in Textiles, Fashion, Business, or a related field; prior experience in a senior merchandising role is highly beneficial.

 This is a full\-time, on\-site Client Servicing Executive role based in Poonamallee. The Client Servicing Executive will manage day\-to\-day client interactions, understand client requirements, and coordinate with internal creative, marketing, and production teams to ensure timely and accurate delivery of campaigns. Responsibilities include preparing and delivering presentations, tracking project progress, resolving client queries, and maintaining detailed documentation of deliverables and feedback. The role also involves supporting account growth by identifying opportunities for additional services, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction, and contributing to the smooth execution of brand communication across multiple media channels.

* Candidates should possess strong Client Services and Client Relations skills to manage expectations and build long\-term partnerships.

* Candidates should possess effective Account Management skills to oversee projects, manage timelines, and coordinate cross\-functional teams.
